'''Aalia Duu-lang''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Crime lord/Legends|Crime lord]]. She was orphaned on the streets by the age of 15 and picked up work in a [[Stassia City]] [[Cantina/Legends|cantina]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Stassia]]. Her shrewdness earned Duu-lang a place in the organization led by crime lord [[Hek Dallan]]. She eventually usurped his organization and went into business for herself.<ref name="Ringers" />
